text:
🗳️ Polls are closed. Now the counting begins.

About 12 million people had voted by 5pm, at nearly 24,000 voting stations.

Every ballot goes through 7 steps at the voting station, watched by party agents and observers: verify, unfold, sort, reconcile, count and bundle, sign the results slips and seal the ballots, then deliver everything to the Municipal Electoral Office.

Who could vote? 29.2 million South Africans were registered (IEC, as at 29 September 2026):
👩 Women: 16.2 million (55%), 3.1 million more than men
🧑 Under 30: 5.5 million (19%)
📊 Biggest group: 30 to 39-year-olds, 6.8 million (23%)
👵 60 and over: 5.8 million (20%)

The councillors these votes elect will set your rates, water and refuse charges for the next five years. The IEC must declare final results within seven days, by 11 November. Follow the count live at results.elections.org.za

Which result are you watching most? 👇
